Products of branch slopes give t³, -t²(4-t)/3, -t³ as appropriate. Independent rational affine-itinerary enumeration over 64 branch triples at t=3.7, 3.79, 3.8, 3.9, 3.936, 3.99 confirms counts 0,0,2,2,2,2. Boundary slope interpretation is carefully excluded at the t1 nonsmooth point.
